messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "some brands have different dosage instructions"
set: ["some brands have different dosage instructions", "some brands have different recommendations", "storage once in use varies for different brands", "generic brands", "some people have thoughts about suicide", "prescribing information contains storage information for different brands while in use", "do not use different brands of semaglutide at the same time", "different medicine", "some young people have thoughts about suicide", "some medicines", "some drugs", "gradually reduce dosage", "read and follow all instructions you have been given", "different age groups", "different while nursing", "different diabetes types"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
